caption: The drawing depicts a box-like structure set on a decorative square base with curled feet at each corner. The box appears to be open at the top, and it is largely black or dark gray in color, rendered using shading to indicate dimensionality. Emerging vertically from the left side of the box is a thin, narrow, and straight pole or rod, which is also dark in color. The base has a layered, stepped design, and is shaded to show depth, with each corner ending in a distinct scroll or curl. The entire composition is centered on an off-white or beige sheet, with no background or additional objects present.
